header.title: D4 baseline: the automatic read on the v0 dev split
header.command: python scripts/eval/run_eval.py --cache 'C:/Users/Jake Mismas/QREP/corpus/private/cache' --out docs/sprint-5/evidence/D4-baseline --title 'D4 baseline: the automatic read on the v0 dev split' --start-sha 3fa671e --workers 2
header.start_sha_check: git diff --quiet 3fa671e HEAD -- qrep/vision/ ':(exclude)qrep/vision/read/' exited 0; git diff --quiet 3fa671e -- qrep/vision/ ':(exclude)qrep/vision/read/' exited 0; qrep imports from C:\Users\Jake Mismas\qrep-wt\d4a\qrep\__init__.py, inside the repo
header.decode_path: native: an untouched full-resolution clean image is passed as its source file, which the reader decodes with the same cv2.imread flags (IMREAD_COLOR), so its pixels are identical; every other image is decoded by cv2.imread (IMREAD_COLOR), resized with INTER_AREA to the cap with the app's targetSize rounding, degraded where its condition says, and staged as a lossless PNG
header.inputs: corpus/manifest.csv, eval_set v0 (sha256 800e36c13104facc9c27d7e217aced9249707b11765bb6966f41bb45dd77e17a), 66 photos in the dev split by tier {'A': 11, 'R': 55}, annotations from corpus/annotations, source images checked against the manifest sha256
header.masks: annotation masks are not applied: the reader sees the whole photo and no score excludes them (#243)
header.simulation: corners from the annotation's outer edge (gate truth, else proposed-a, else proposed-b), jitter radii [0, 2, 4, 6, 8] px, 3 draws per nonzero radius, seed 'd4a'; auto-corners receives those corners and a fabric count when 2 to 12 (a square-truth claim, or the proposal on a row that is not gate; a gate row with only a proposed count gives none); the automatic read takes no counts, so the true counts reach only the confirmed reader, with the same corners and fabric count; picker answer 'Works with these' for every photo
header.full_resolution_budget: 50 MP per as-fetched unit (corpus.FULL_BUDGET_MP; #166 comments 6145839899 and 6146139041), on every split: a unit whose reader would be handed an uncapped image above it, judged after any degradation that shrinks the image, is never read; its rows stand where its reads would be (auto's read, each corner trial, the confirmed reader's miscounts) and carry skip_kind over_budget, except a corner reader with no frame to confirm, which keeps its no-frame row; they are listed beside every rate, never counted as a read, refusal, success or failure; a capped unit is never over it, and the named fixture rows are outside this tally. In this run: clean units 66 as fetched, 2 skipped; stress units 36 as fetched, 5 skipped; photos skipped: smithsonian-chndm-1972-28-1, smithsonian-chndm-1973-45-1; the largest image read as fetched: 5038 x 7721 px (smithsonian-chndm-1986-27-1). Why: measured 2026-10-13 on dev photos, each step alone in a fresh process, as peak working set / peak commit (#166 comments 6145827537, 6146146558 and 6146429860): at 78e92e3 the automatic read took 0.50 / 1.20 GB at 8.9 MP, 1.18 / 1.88 GB at 15.4 MP and 1.00 / 1.70 GB at 38.9 MP, and under a 5 GB per-process commit cap both the automatic read (a 456 MiB float32 power spectrum in the padded block autocorrelation, qrep/vision/repeats.py) and the glare degradation failed on the 117.5 MP scan; banded in 419388c, glare takes 0.89 / 1.61 GB and the lighting gradient 0.87 / 1.59 GB on that scan, while the read still fails as fetched and is not the eval's to change; the scan's low_res_jpeg unit, which hands the read 541 x 600 px, takes 0.70 / 1.41 GB as fetched
header.degradations: grayscale {}; lighting_gradient {'factor_left': 1.0, 'factor_right': 0.55}; low_res_jpeg {'longest_px': 600, 'jpeg_quality': 40}; gaussian_blur {'sigma_px': 2.0}; glare {'center_of_field': [0.35, 0.35], 'sigma_of_short_side': 0.15, 'peak_blend_to_white': 0.85}; occlusion {'center_of_field': [0.6, 0.6], 'side_of_field': 0.25, 'gray': 128}, applied at every requested resolution, at true corners, to museum tier A photos licensed CC0-1.0
header.truth: 0 gate rows, 1008 provisional rows, 0 conflict rows, 8 synthetic rows
header.proposal_disagreements: 0 of 11 tier A photos have proposed-a and proposed-b counts or classes that differ: none
header.low_confidence_flag: auto readers flag squares below 0.9 (the old app's UNCERTAIN_THRESHOLD); the confirmed reader flags none until its result carries flags (#237); a read with no confidences flags none and its row says confidence_missing
